name: agent-memory
description: Persistent agent memory in a git repository, an Obsidian knowledge vault indexed by MemPalace, and the skills that fill them: notes, video and PDF extraction, browser automation, skill quality checks, diagrams, LaTeX, safe commits.

memory_dir.title: Agent memory folder
memory_dir.description: A git repository of markdown files the agent remembers across sessions and projects. /agent-memory:setup creates it if it does not exist. Example: ~/agent-memory

vault_dir.title: Obsidian vault folder
vault_dir.description: The Obsidian vault where knowledge notes go. /agent-memory:setup can create a starter vault here.

notes_language.title: Language of your notes
notes_language.description: Language the note-writing skills write in. Skill instructions stay in English.

memory_autopush.title: Push memory to its remote
memory_autopush.description: After each turn, commit memory changes and push them to the memory repository's private remote, if one is set.
